description: Source code for the HttpssvcMetrics class and related functions, handling DNS metrics and HTTPS query statistics within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpssvcMetrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and recording DNS and HTTPS resolution metrics, including resolve times and DNS response codes.

methods.name: TranslateDnsRcodeForHttpssvcExperiment
methods.description: Converts DNS RCODE values to HttpssvcDnsRcode enum for experiment analysis.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::HttpssvcMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing the metrics object with security status.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveForAddressQuery
methods.description: Records resolve time and updates disqualification status based on RCODE.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveAddressQueryFailure
methods.description: Marks the metrics as disqualified due to address query failure.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveForHttps
methods.description: Stores HTTPS RCODE, record count, and parsability status for an HTTPS query.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::BuildMetricName
methods.description: Constructs a metric name string based on query parameters and context.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::RecordMetrics
methods.description: Records collected metrics into histograms, including resolve times and response codes.
